meta.name: chrome-automation
meta.description: 网页开发工程师与运营专员在需要自动化现有 Chrome 浏览器时必用！通过 CDP 协议无缝接管当前浏览器，自动配置环境并实时可视化执行任务。完美保留登录状态，一键完成复杂网页自动化流程，让繁琐操作自动化。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接管当前 Chrome 自动完成网页操作，保留登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要在网页上重复执行操作且需要保留登录状态。
copy.tagline_en: Automate tedious web flows in an existing Chrome with login preserved.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely repeat manual steps in a browser and need to stay logged in.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 CDP 连接你本机的 Chrome(9222 端口),在你眼前可见的浏览器窗口里打开网页、点选元素、填表并截图,把每步结果截屏告诉你;首次运行还会自动装好依赖,登录状态会保留。
howto.when: 当你要自动化现有的 Chrome 浏览器时(例如网页搜索、填表单、抓取页面结果等)会启用;使用前它先跑自动安装脚本,再接管浏览器执行。

say.text: 打开小红书搜 labubu,把结果截图给我
say.note: 浏览器窗口里实时执行并截图

say.text: 帮我在 example.com/form 填好表单并提交
say.note: 先用 snapshot 定位元素再填入

say.text: 连接我当前的 Chrome,看现在打开的是哪个网址

howto.what_en: Claude connects via CDP to the Chrome on your machine (port 9222), then opens pages, clicks elements, fills forms and screenshots in the browser window you can watch. It runs an auto-install first and keeps your login state.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need to automate your existing Chrome browser, such as web search, filling forms or capturing page results. Before any automation it runs the auto-install script and takes over the browser.

say_en.text: Open Xiaohongshu and search for labubu, screenshot the results
say_en.note: Runs live and screenshots each step

say_en.text: Fill in the form at example.com/form and submit it
Connect to my current Chrome and tell me the open URL
